description: Land Acquisition - Orugodawatta, Meethotamulla Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific lands (Lots 1-120) are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, extents, and locations, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land acquisition matters.
